text:
incident-bot: [P1] multiple NotReady events detected in inference-pool-eu-west (nodes x4) over 8m. Pod churn on gpu-serving namespace. Pager: @engineer-oncall.

jules: ack, I'm on pager. Seeing kubelet restarts and containerd OOM logs on 4 nodes.

engineer-oncall: paging infra (omar) for host-level investigation. @omar can you take lead?

omar: taking. quick glance at node logs: repeated `kubelet invoked oom-killer` around the time containers try to initialize CUDA. Container stderrs show `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` immediately followed by kubelet groking memory spike.

nina: customer impact: routing errors for ~12% of requests to models on eu-west. Major accounts hitting retries. No persistent database issues but elevated 5xx.

jules: suspect interaction between the new kernel and nvidia driver packaging in the last AMI bake. We rolled AMI tag ami-infer-2026-04-11 three days ago.

omar: pulled dmesg from a flapped host: ```[ 3542.123456] Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (kubelet) total-vm:...
[ 3542.123457] kubelet invoked oom-killer: gfp_mask=0x201da, order=0...
[ 3542.123460] NVRM: GPU crash dump...
[ 3542.123462] nvidia: probe error - module version mismatch```

engineer-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon and drain the 4 NotReady/flapping nodes 2) scale up ASG with older AMI 3) route critical traffic to inference-gpu-secondary pool 4) disable automatic AMI promotion until we validate driver/kernel combos.

omar: executed `kubectl cordon node-eu-01` + `kubectl drain ... --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for 4 nodes. New nodes in the ASG launched with latest image and exhibited same failure. Rolled scale to use autoscaling group with tag `bake:stable-2026-03-29`.

nina: traffic switch in progress. @infra-bot please confirm split.

infra-bot: action: traffic-router updated -> inference-gpu-primary 30%, inference-gpu-secondary 70%.

jules: note: one host appeared to recover after systemd restarted containerd but then kubelet hit steady memory growth and OOMed again. Restarting kubelet in-place is temporary and leads to churn.

omar: we traced memory leak to kubelet metrics exporter combined with cgroup v2 accounting on this kernel version; exporter was holding references leading to kernel memory spike during container start (especially with gpu workload). There's also a mismatch in DKMS-built nvidia module causing additional allocations on init.

engineer-oncall: action: disable metrics-exporter daemonset on gpu nodes as quick mitigation (rolled out to affected AZ). Also we pinned node group to older AMI.

infra-bot: autoscaling group update: desired-capacity -> 22 (added 6 nodes) with AMI stable-2026-03-29.

nina: early results: error rate halved within 10m; p95 from 1.4s -> 320ms. Some customers still see retries. CS-ops looped in for external comms.

jules: flags for post-incident: 1) prevent kernel/driver mismatch via AMI validation 2) add cgroup-v2 + kubelet memory regression test in bake CI 3) add alert for successive kubelet restarts on node (threshold 3 in 5m) 4) create canary pool for new AMIs before full promotion.

omar: infra will roll back the AMI promotion and start a controlled bake with nv module compile sanity tests. Also adding a preflight that runs `LD_PRELOAD=libnvidia-ml.so cuda-sanity` as smoke.

engineer-oncall: handoff note: I'm handing to @omar for rollback and infra coordination, @jules continue monitoring routing and client-side retries, @nina hold on CS comms. I'm off pager in 40m.

omar: taking over. initiating image rollback and disabling AMI auto-promotion. Commands & timestamps logged to internal runbook gist: https://redwood.gist/ef56gh (internal).

infra-bot: action: AMI promotion disabled; rollback initiated to AMI stable-2026-03-29 in eu-west ASG.

nina: CS-ops draft posted for review: we told impacted customers we're mitigating and routing traffic; timeline estimate 1-2 hours for stabilization.

jules: monitoring: as nodes with stable AMI join, kubelet churn drops; current NotReady nodes 0; p95 250ms; error rate ~0.4%.

omar: follow-ups created: RD-OPS-2101 (AMI bake driver/kernel assertions), RD-OBS-2102 (kubelet-restart alert), RD-SEC-2103 (stop auto-driver upgrades without bake validation).

engineer-oncall: final checks before I step out: confirm no remaining crashloop pods, validate node kubelet memory baseline for 30m, ensure canary promotion path created.

jules: confirmed: no CrashLoopBackOff in gpu-serving, metrics-exporter disabled, canary pool created with label `ami:canary-verify`.

omar: infra notes: driver module rebuild fixed in new bake; will only promote after smoke tests pass.

cs-ops: posting status update to customers now.

engineer-oncall: thanks team. Incident moved to monitoring state. Postmortem owners: jules (write), omar (AMI bake improvements), nina (customer comms). Closing active pager in 25m if stable. :white_check_mark:
